mapper.select: SELECT tab.book_id,tab.customer_name,tab.account_template_id,tab.vat_type,tab.current_period,bat.name accountTemplateName,1 isCurrentBook from t_account_book tab LEFT JOIN book_account_template bat ON tab.account_template_id = bat.account_template_id where tab.book_id = #{bookId}

SELECT tab.book_id,tab.customer_name,tab.account_template_id,tab.vat_type,tab.current_period, bat.name accountTemplateName,IF(#{bookId}=tab.book_id,1,0)isCurrentBook from t_account_book tab LEFT JOIN book_account_template bat ON tab.account_template_id = bat.account_template_id where tab.dept_id = #{companyId} and tab.server_status = '正常服务' and tab.status = 0 order by create_time desc
